fusions.name: Full-Gallop Shoulder
fusions.desc: You rush up to 8 tiles to the target and drive into it, which deals 16 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stampede Line
fusions.desc: Thunders through a narrow cone 5 tiles long, which deals 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Barded Charger
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed rises 30% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Momentum Carried
fusions.desc: When you have covered a stretch of ground, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
